summary: Mallow was a Nomai who worked at the Orbital Probe Cannon as part of the Ash Twin Project. Spouse of Avens, Mallow proposed using a probe to find the Eye visually and joined Avens in deliberately overpowering the cannon — the decision that breaks it every loop.

behavior: Mallow was passionate about finding the Eye of the Universe.
Mallow dismissed concerns about compromising the Orbital Probe Cannon's structural integrity since the cannon only needed to fire once.
location: Mallow worked on the Orbital Probe Cannon in orbit around Giant's Deep.
Mallow joined Avens, Daz, and Cassava at the Construction Yard on Giant's Deep when the project paused.
Mallow's remains are presumably with Avens's at the Construction Yard.
lore: Mallow was a member of the Nomai and of the Ash Twin Project team.
Mallow was the spouse of Avens.
Mallow noted the Nomai concluded the Eye is in orbit around the Sun based on Quantum Moon observations.
Mallow proposed finding the Eye visually with a probe since the Nomai knew what it looks like from the Quantum Moon.
Mallow's probe proposal eventually led to the Orbital Probe Cannon being built.
Mallow and Avens were responsible for testing and adjusting the Orbital Probe Cannon's launch power.
Mallow and Avens decided to ignore Daz's safe maximum power setting to maximize the probe's reach.
Mallow told Privet not to worry about the cannon breaking since they only needed to fire once.
Mallow was on the Orbital Probe Cannon with Privet when the Ash Twin Project was put on hold.
Avens and Mallow's power adjustment proved fatal: the Orbital Probe Cannon now breaks apart on launch each loop.
The Probe Tracking Module disappears into Giant's Deep's core after the cannon breaks.
